verdict.rationale: Mangopay's docs say that on a chargeback the funds are automatically deducted from the wallet and returned to the payer. A dispute object is created, and the platform can contest it by providing proof. This covers the core of per-wallet chargeback handling and evidence-based contestation. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that disputes attach to the specific seller/sub-merchant wallet rather than a platform wallet, documented evidence-submission channels (API endpoint or dashboard flow), automatic re-crediting of seller balances when a dispute is won, dispute-specific webhook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
